# wallabidi v0.4.2 - Table of Contents

> Concurrent browser testing for Elixir, powered by WebDriver BiDi. A fork of Wallaby.

## Modules

- [Wallabidi](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.md): A concurrent feature testing library.
- [Wallabidi.Browser](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.Browser.md): The Browser module is the entrypoint for interacting with a real browser.
- [Wallabidi.BrowserPaths](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.BrowserPaths.md): Finds browser binaries — either a local binary to launch or a remote
URL to connect to.
- [Wallabidi.DSL](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.DSL.md): Sets up the Wallabidi DSL in a module.
- [Wallabidi.Element](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.Element.md): Defines an Element Struct and interactions with Elements.
- [Wallabidi.Feature](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.Feature.md): Helpers for writing features.
- [Wallabidi.Helpers.KeyCodes](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.Helpers.KeyCodes.md): Shortcuts for various keys.
- [Wallabidi.LiveView](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.LiveView.md): Helpers for testing LiveView pages where you need to observe state
*during* a server round-trip — not just after it completes.
- [Wallabidi.LiveView.Driver](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.LiveView.Driver.md): Direct LiveView driver — connects to LiveViews via Phoenix channels
without a browser. Same wallabidi API, no Chrome/Docker required.
- [Wallabidi.Query](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.Query.md): Provides the query DSL.
- [Wallabidi.Session](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.Session.md): Struct containing details about the webdriver session.

- [Wallabidi.Test.AwaitMonitor](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.Test.AwaitMonitor.md): Detects event-driven-await regressions per test.

- Exceptions
  - [Wallabidi.BadMetadataError](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.BadMetadataError.md)
  - [Wallabidi.CookieError](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.CookieError.md)
  - [Wallabidi.DependencyError](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.DependencyError.md)
  - [Wallabidi.DriverError](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.DriverError.md)
  - [Wallabidi.ExpectationNotMetError](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.ExpectationNotMetError.md)
  - [Wallabidi.JSError](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.JSError.md)
  - [Wallabidi.NavigationTimeoutError](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.NavigationTimeoutError.md)
  - [Wallabidi.NoBaseUrlError](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.NoBaseUrlError.md)
  - [Wallabidi.QueryError](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.QueryError.md)
  - [Wallabidi.StaleReferenceError](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Wallabidi.StaleReferenceError.md)

## Mix Tasks

- [mix test.browsers](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Test.Browsers.md): Runs the integration test suite once per listed browser.
- [mix wallabidi.install](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Wallabidi.Install.md): Installs Chrome for Testing, Lightpanda, and the chromium-bidi
server's Node deps — everything the browser drivers need, into one
project-local `.browsers/` dir.
- [mix wallabidi.install.chrome](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Wallabidi.Install.Chrome.md): Installs Chrome for Testing and the chromium-bidi server's Node deps
into `.browsers/`, recording the binary path in `.browsers/PATHS`.
- [mix wallabidi.install.lightpanda](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Wallabidi.Install.Lightpanda.md): Installs the Lightpanda binary into a version-stamped
`.browsers/lightpanda/<target>-<release>/` dir (mirroring Chrome's
`.browsers/chrome/<target>-<version>/` layout so releases coexist) and
records the binary path in `.browsers/PATHS`.
- [mix wallabidi.minify](https://wallabidi.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Wallabidi.Minify.md): Regenerates `priv/wallabidi.min.js` from `priv/wallabidi.js` using esbuild.
